statement: theorem labelled_hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (y : ℝ) (z : E) : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z x) 0) ∧ (∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) x ↔ y * inner ℝ z x ≠ 1) ∧ (Differentiable ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) ↔ y • z = 0)
